title: 13.9. Dassanahetuttika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Dassanena pahātabbahetukaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nadassanena pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā chabbīsa, ārammaṇe ekavīsa, adhipatiyā ekūnavīsa …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate chabbīsa. (Vitthāretabbaṁ.)
